@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M5QWG18ZZAMS370KT33CTVTY
+- 01M5QWJGM1679S6CWHFCST7WAN
+- 01M5QWJXZ5EEBVH7Z9D3W7JKFN
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'MTP: draft more than one token per round by chaining the Qwen MTP head'
+---
+## What
+`Qwen35MTPDraftModel.maximumBlockSize = 2` (Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/Qwen35MTP.swift), so each round drafts one token, and the best case is 2 tokens for each verify (measured: 1.70–1.96). vLLM #62961 runs Qwen3.8-27B with 3 MTP tokens and reports a mean acceptance length of ~3.1. Chain the head: draft k+1 uses the MTP output hidden of draft k as its "previous hidden", and the drafter cache gets one tentative entry for each draft.
+
+- [ ] In `draftMTPTokenBlock` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/QwenMTP.swift), loop for `blockSize - 1` drafts and feed back the MTP hidden and the sampled token. Track `proposalAppended` for each tentative entry.
+- [ ] In `commitDrafterState` (Qwen35MTP.swift), trim the rejected tentative entries and append the accepted ones with the target hidden rows, so that the drafter = main - 1 contract stays true.
+- [ ] Raise `maximumBlockSize` (for example to 4). Make the default `blockSize` for Qwen3.8 a measured choice, and allow it in `SpeculativeDecodingConfig(mtpDrafter:blockSize:)`.
+- [ ] The target `maximumNativeTargetCacheRewind` (Qwen35.swift ~1332, now 1) must cover `blockSize - 1`: extend the GDN checkpoint to the accepted position (`mtpCacheCheckpointIndexKey` = accepted index), with the checkpoint outputs of the T ≤ 4 GDN kernel.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Greedy output equals plain decode for blockSize 2, 3, and 4.
+- [ ] `qwen38FourBitMTPGeneration` with blockSize 3 and 4 (add both to the benchmark): the best blockSize gives ≥ 15% more MTP tok/s on the math category than blockSize 2 after the compiled-verify task.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35MTPTests.swift: blockSize 3/4 equality with plain greedy, drafter-count invariant after partial acceptance, and GDN rewind by 1–3 positions.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes; then run the Release benchmark.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #perf
\ No newline at end of file
